cases.title: One pair in focus (Bar's Trim Paths End): no demonstration, a walkthrough in words

rubric.reason: In turn 3, asked "Can you show me how?" with only Bar's End in focus, the mentor declines a demo in one sentence ("With only this one move to work on, I'll leave the hands-on part to you"), then walks through the current step in words with no numbers (open Trim Paths 1, click End, choose Edit Speed Graph).

Every name and time matches the tool output: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s, Scale, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle/Bar/Glow ease-first refs, Bar's End 0.2–1.2 s, and the path "Contents › Rectangle › Contents › Trim Paths 1" matches display_path.

Each turn moves one idea and ends with something to answer: turn 1 ends on the land-hard question, turn 2 on the reading question, and turn 3 answers the side question in two sentences then repeats the pending reading question in one.

With the single pair Bar's End 0.2–1.2 s in focus (no_demo_reason "single_target"), Turn 3 does not demonstrate. It says "if I shaped it for you there'd be nothing left for you to do, so this one is all yours. I'll walk you through each step," then gives the pending step in words (select Bar, open the Graph Editor, choose Edit Speed Graph) with no numbers; the handle steps belong to the later explanation turn.

Every name and time matches the tool output or the record: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (4.367 rounded), its Scale, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and Bar's End 0.2–1.2 s; Title being eased before comes from eased_layers.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on something to answer. Turn 1 proposes Title and lists one leave-out per kind, ending on the land-hard question. Turn 2 names Bar's End and asks the reading question. Turn 3 answers the demo request in two sentences and restates the pending step in one, without adding the next stage.

In turn 3 the mentor gives the one-sentence reason with no demo ('With only one move to shape here, I won't do it for you, or there'd be nothing left for you to try'), then walks the pending step in words (the curve's highest point is where the move is fastest) with no numbers; the lesson never reaches the shaping stage, so the handle walkthrough isn't due yet.

Every name and time is backed by tool output or the record: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (from 4.367), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, Bar's End 0.2 to 1.2 s, and Title as the layer eased before (eased_layers).

Each turn moves one step and ends on a question: turn 1 is the proposal with one-line leave-outs and the land-hard question, turn 2 is the reading question, and turn 3 answers the side question in two sentences and then repeats the pending reading question.
